scope: Evaluation and evidence quality; 14 core records, primary publications or official methods guidance. No experiments or reserved-example inspection.

sources.title: Cochrane Handbook, Chapter 5: Collecting data
sources.checked_claim: Studies and their multiple reports must be linked; conflicting reports require documented handling.
sources.limits: Intervention-review guidance; not an automatic biomedical entity-resolution algorithm.
sources.project_relevance: Avoid counting multiple records or papers as independent experiments.
sources.reuse_status: Conceptual control immediately applicable; no code installed.
sources.license_status: Guidance read and linked; redistribution terms not reviewed.

sources.title: GRADE: an emerging consensus on rating quality of evidence and strength of recommendations
sources.type: primary methods framework with current official implementation guidance
sources.checked_claim: Evidence certainty differs from recommendation strength; current guidance evaluates an outcome-specific body of evidence.
sources.limits: Not a graph-edge probability or a universal molecular-assay quality scale.
sources.project_relevance: Separate source fidelity, model confidence and scientific certainty.
sources.reuse_status: Use framework boundaries; no automated grading proposed.
sources.license_status: BMJ copyright visible; no permission to redistribute handbook/tool content inferred.

sources.title: RoB 2: a revised tool for assessing risk of bias in randomised trials
sources.type: primary methods paper and official assessment tool
sources.checked_claim: Official versions distinguish individually randomized parallel, cluster and crossover trials.
sources.limits: Direct BMJ full text blocked; tool site checked. Not applicable unchanged to all study designs or assays.
sources.project_relevance: Prefer attributed, scoped bias assessments to invented reliability scores.
sources.reuse_status: Reference framework; integration requires applicable assessment and terms review.
sources.license_status: Official site states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for tools.

sources.title: CIViC Assertion, evidence level and evidence direction curation guidance
sources.checked_claim: Assertions synthesize EIDs using context-specific interpretation systems; predictive Does Not Support includes inconclusive evidence.
sources.limits: Upstream interpretation is not independent validation if supplied as the answer input.
sources.project_relevance: Preserve disease/profile/regimen scope and distinguish lack of support from resistance.
sources.reuse_status: Existing local integration; complete scope/curation audit before new synthesis.
sources.license_status: CIViC data CC0; linked publications and guidelines have separate terms.

sources.title: Benchmarking the impact of data leakage on the performance of knowledge graph embedding models for biomedical link prediction
sources.checked_claim: Author abstract reports redundant-relation controls and weaker external Orphanet transfer; no evidence of degree-only prediction in its tests.
sources.limits: Full publisher text inaccessible in this review; abstract and official README inspected. External task is not our CRC endpoint.
sources.project_relevance: Reusable leakage/cold-start audit before future graph prediction.
sources.reuse_status: Candidate code, not installed; Python 3.10 and TorchKGE/PyG workflow documented.
sources.license_status: Repository MIT; underlying KG/data terms require separate checking.

sources.title: Node-degree aware edge sampling mitigates inflated classification performance in biomedical random walk-based graph representation learning
sources.checked_claim: Sampling strategy changes estimated performance; author notebooks include KG-IDG and degree-only controls.
sources.limits: Abstract/repository reviewed; full publisher methods inaccessible. Findings concern specified random-walk classification settings.
sources.project_relevance: Audit sampled negatives and degree/popularity baselines rather than assuming absent edges are false.
sources.reuse_status: Candidate GRAPE notebooks, not run; full-method compatibility review required.
sources.license_status: Official repository GPL-3.0; not interchangeable with permissive code licensing.

sources.title: Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs; ogbl-biokg protocol
sources.checked_claim: BioKG uses random splits and type-restricted corrupted candidates for ranking; heterogeneous evidence confidence is documented.
sources.limits: Sampled alternatives are not measured biological negatives. Random splitting does not establish temporal or entity generalization.
sources.project_relevance: Standard evaluator candidate for an explicitly defined link task, not global scientific accuracy.
sources.reuse_status: Protocol inspected; no data downloaded or evaluation run.
sources.license_status: Official page labels ogbl-biokg CC0; other datasets have different licenses.

sources.title: Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims
sources.checked_claim: Scientific claims have abstract-level support/refutation and rationale annotations.
sources.limits: Abstract-based textual support is not evidence synthesis; our supplied-document adaptation excludes retrieval.
sources.project_relevance: Existing component benchmark and rationale-completeness controls.
sources.reuse_status: Already integrated locally; retain consumed/exposed status and published task boundaries.
sources.license_status: Project's prior license audit: claims/annotations CC BY 4.0, corpus ODC-By 1.0, code Apache-2.0. License file linked; rendered body unavailable this review.

sources.title: NLI4CT: Multi-Evidence Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trial Reports
sources.checked_claim: Paper separates inference/evidence retrieval; section 9.2 reports no significant benefit from gold-evidence-only input for evaluated baselines.
sources.limits: Binary trial task. Section 9.1 reports test-F1 checkpoint selection; do not copy that choice into our freeze policy.
sources.project_relevance: Trial-context/numerical diagnostic; does not establish source-wide or CRC validity.
sources.reuse_status: Already evaluated locally; consumed holdouts remain historical.
sources.license_status: Organizer dataset redistribution license unresolved in existing pinned audit; participant code/model terms separate.

sources.title: Evidence Inference 2.0: More Data, Better Models
sources.checked_claim: The task conditions comparative reported effects on intervention, comparator and outcome, with supporting evidence.
sources.limits: Result-direction labels differ from entailment/refutation/NEI; clinical trial scope does not cover every molecular relation.
sources.project_relevance: Established question/qualification structure for comparative treatment evidence.
sources.reuse_status: Candidate baseline and annotation model; runtime/checkpoint compatibility not established.
sources.license_status: Official repository displays MIT; linked article full-text terms remain separate.

sources.title: Evaluating Language Models for Biomedical Fact-Checking: A Benchmark Dataset for Cancer Variant Interpretation Verification
sources.checked_claim: Cancer-variant claims are paired with evidence and expert reviews; released March 2025 model uses NEI/SUPPORTS/REFUTES.
sources.limits: Versions differ; augmentation, label policy and fine-tuning membership affect interpretation. PubMed marks retrieved report as preprint.
sources.project_relevance: Closest domain reference and already-used baseline; retain expert disagreement and overlap accounting.
sources.reuse_status: Already integrated locally, not a fresh holdout by default.
sources.license_status: Model card MIT; repository root did not establish blanket code/data license. Article rights separate.

sources.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
sources.checked_claim: Temperature scaling is a simple post-hoc calibration method evaluated on image/document classifiers.
sources.limits: Requires representative separate calibration observations; neither accuracy improvement nor domain-shift protection follows automatically.
sources.project_relevance: Evaluate model probabilities rather than presenting raw confidence as truth likelihood.
sources.reuse_status: Method candidate; author demo explicitly unmaintained, PyTorch 0.3, not a current package recommendation.

sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
sources.checked_claim: Reject-option classification trades coverage against error risk; author implementation covers VGG/CIFAR and risk control.
sources.limits: Published image-task guarantees do not automatically transfer to biomedical claims or dependent samples.
sources.project_relevance: Matched-coverage false-support comparison; distinguish refusal from semantic NEI.
sources.reuse_status: Reuse evaluation concepts; not a ready biomedical model.
sources.license_status: No explicit license visible in inspected root; copying code requires resolution.

sources.title: Conformal Prediction: A Gentle Introduction
sources.type: author methods tutorial with official example code
sources.checked_claim: Prediction-set coverage depends on stated sampling/exchangeability assumptions; extensions address particular shifts.
sources.limits: Marginal coverage differs from per-case/subgroup correctness; dependence and shift cannot be ignored.
sources.project_relevance: Later uncertainty option, after adequate independent calibration and reference validity.
sources.reuse_status: Full-text assumptions and example repository inspected; deferred, not implemented.
sources.license_status: Example repository MIT; arXiv article license separate.
